text:
oliver: Quick copy review for the IP allowlist toggle in Org Settings. Right now the toggle label says "Enable IP allowlist" and the helper text reads "Only requests from listed IPs will be allowed." Security wants clearer language about service tokens and API keys.
neha: +1. Also UX tested users who thought this blocks console access; we should call out scope (API traffic vs Console).
samir: Draft suggestion: Toggle label: "Enable IP allowlist (restrict API access)" Helper text: "When on, only requests from listed IP addresses can use API keys and service tokens. Console access from managed sessions is not blocked." Short and explicit.
oliver: I like it but avoid parentheses in labels for localization. Maybe move the parenthetical into the help text or a tooltip.
neha: Accessibility nit: the helper text is currently only visually adjacent. Make it programmatically tied with aria-describedby and ensure the toggle control has an accessible name that includes status.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: toggle must be a focusable checkbox/ switch role, have aria-checked, aria-describedby pointing to helper text id, and helper text under 200 chars. If a tooltip expands details, ensure it's keyboard reachable.
security-bot: Security note: we should include a short warning when enabling: "Enabling restricts API access to listed IPs only. If you use non-IP-bound service tokens, rotate tokens before enabling." Keep the warning <140 chars and put it as a caution callout below the helper text. Also add a link to the IP allowlist runbook.
samir: Revised microcopy proposal:
Label: Enable IP allowlist
Helper text: Only requests from listed IP addresses will be allowed to use API keys and service tokens. Console sessions are not affected.
Caution (callout): Enabling will restrict API access to listed IPs. If you use tokens from unlisted locations, rotate or update them first. Learn more 12 runbook link.
Primary CTA (save): Save changes
Secondary CTA: Cancel

neha: Tiny language tweak: replace "tokens from unlisted locations" with "tokens used from unlisted IPs" 12 clearer. Also prefer "update" -> "whitelist"? Maybe: "rotate or whitelist them first".
oliver: Good pickup. For tone, keep it active voice and short. Also add an audit footer: "Action recorded in Audit Log" (small text). Security-bot, is the rotate wording okay?
security-bot: Yes. Suggest final caution: "If existing tokens are used from unlisted IPs, rotate or whitelist them before enabling." That's precise. Also require a secondary confirmation modal when enabling for orgs with >50 active tokens.
a11y-bot: If you show a confirmation modal, ensure focus lands on the modal and the warning is read by screen readers via role=alertdialog. Provide a checkbox to confirm understanding for high-risk orgs.
neha: I'll update the Figma components and include the tooltip and warning callout variants. Samir, can you provide i18n keys: `ipAllowlist.label`, `.helper`, `.caution`, `.cta_save`, `.cta_cancel`, `.audit_note`?
samir: Will do. I'll also add placeholder for the runbook URL. Posting updated mocks in ~15m. :memo:
